title: plugin-sharing: a failed business-unit head or standalone manager read still answers null and caches it for the pass (headOf, managerOf fallback)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXsK9j25sd7eVwW96G

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding of the #29655 dev (os-dev-report 6593642509, "headOf still catches a failed unit read to null"), escalated under ③ by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on PR #29703 (6593863224, head `483976d8`) as a follow-up card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3. Today no grant is computed from either read on `main`.

**Business reason.** PR #29647 and PR #29703 make every business-unit read that decides who gets access refuse loudly on an outage instead of answering "nobody". Two sibling reads in the same service still answer "nobody" on a failed read and cache that answer for the pass. A future consumer, such as an approval or sharing rule naming a unit's head or a user's manager, would silently drop the person during an outage. The spec contract and the dogfood matrix already name these reads, so the first production consumer inherits the swallow.

## What happens

Read from source at `origin/main`, in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`:

- `BusinessUnitGraphService.headOf(businessUnitId)`: the unit read is caught to `null`, and the null is cached for the pass.
- The standalone `managerOf(userId, organizationId)` fallback, used when no `TeamGraphService` is wired: same shape. The wired path already screens through `TeamGraphService.managerOf`.

## Wanted

- A failed read throws (or refuses) instead of answering `null`. Absence (`isObjectAbsentError`) still answers `null`. Nothing is cached after a failed read. This is the same shape as PR #29703's `seedIsUsable` and `readChildUnits`.
- Pins per method: a failed read refuses, absence answers `null`, and a failed read is not cached (a second call after recovery answers the real head or manager). Ablate each negative pin once.

Serial: after PR #29703 (#29655, same file).

Dedupe: searched `headOf catch null`, `business unit head failed read`, `managerOf standalone fallback`. The nearest are #29655 and #29606 (the seed, descent and member reads). **New.**

Links back: #29655, PR #29703, #29606, PR #29647.
